tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (DN-MOPD): it pinpoints a concrete, under-examined failure mode—feedback scale imbalance across teachers—that generalizes beyond its domain-routing setup and is backed by clear, reproducible gains (+1–3 pp across model sizes). Follow with Paper 2, whose scaling-law framing for encoder-free MLLMs offers a complementary methodological lens on how architectural choices interact with compute budgets. Paper 3 (Physical Coding/HexaAnything) is more niche but connects thematically to #1 through self-improvement training loops and to #2 via the question of what scale and structure are needed for embodied agents to generalize.
tips_zh: 建议先读第1篇（DN-MOPD）：它精准指出了一个常被忽视的失败模式——多教师之间的反馈尺度不平衡，这一发现不仅适用于其领域路由场景，还具有更广泛的借鉴意义，且实验增益明确可复现（在多个模型规模上提升1–3个百分点）。接着读第2篇，它从标度律角度对无编码器多模态大模型的分析，与第1篇在训练方法论上形成互补。第3篇（Physical Coding/HexaAnything）方向较为垂直，但与第1篇在自改进训练循环、与第2篇在具身智能的规模与结构如何影响泛化能力方面存在主题关联。
